first.rationale: Current data shows both activation and onboarding completion declining 4-6% QoQ, signaling degradation in self-serve funnel health. Memory_31 and memory_86 together demonstrate that onboarding simplification directly improves both completion rates and early activation—the two metrics now in decline. While promotional_pricing addresses competitive pressure, it risks commoditizing the segment and creating unsustainable margin pressure. Simplifying onboarding is a lever we know works, addresses the actual funnel metric declines, and produces durable long-term behavior change rather than short-term discounting. This aligns with maximizing sustainable qualified revenue. Verification of the original experiment records will confirm effect sizes and segment specificity before rolling out. A standard experiment allows us to test without over-committing if segment dynamics have shifted.
